integrity: The complete all-parameter proof is analytic. Finite numerical diagnostics support but do not establish the limits. No independent mathematical audit or certified formal verification is represented.
scientific_limitations: Fixed strictly positive Lindley rates and conditional-shape parameters; coupling tends to infinity; no uniform parameter bounds, rank convergence rate, uniqueness of the negative Pearson minimum, or finite-coupling perfect negative copula. The 1988 originating exponential-conditionals full paper was not accessible, so historical priority is provisional. No independent review has occurred.
title: Inverse-rank collapse with vanishing Pearson correlation in bivariate power-Lindley survival models
